Chapter 471: Chapter 14: The Long Three Hundred Years (Subscription Wanted)

“Such an aura of an Immortal King…”

The purple-robed elder gazed towards Xianyao City, or to be precise, at the vast expanse under the firmament above Xianyao City.

To the eyes of a True Immortal, there was nothing there, and even ordinary Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings would not notice anything amiss.

But in the eyes of the purple-robed elder, a grand world was evolving, vast and boundless, and the breath it emitted was no weaker than the aura of an ordinary Immortal King.

“The aura is actually that of a whole world…”

...

The purple-robed elder’s mind trembled, as the aura of most Immortal Kings was the outer image of some object, such as a heavenly pillar or an ocean.

But the grand world aura before him was not so much an aura as a collection of countless other auras.

“Martial Ancestor is definitely not a freshly ascended Immortal King…”

The purple-robed elder collected his thoughts. How could the aura of a newly ascended Immortal King be so grand? Although the aura of an Immortal King is to some extent an indication of their strength, it’s not absolute.

But the grand aura the purple-robed elder was observing, how could an ordinary Immortal King present such a display? Within the boundless world, many wonders were included. Even those who had cultivated for a million years, the peak Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings, could not achieve such a feat.

“Only a Supreme Immortal King, one in full control of the Power of Creation, could condense such a level of an aura.”

The purple-robed elder took a deep breath. There are two types of Tribulation Stage Celestial Kings.

One is the regular Immortal King, which includes the newly ascended Immortal Kings, ordinary Immortal Kings, Veteran Immortal Kings, and Peak Immortal Kings.

The difference in strength among these four levels largely depends on their control of the Power of Creation; however, the gap is not too large.

Even a Peak Immortal King would have difficulty killing a newly ascended Immortal King.

By the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, after overcoming the Bodily and Mind Tribulations and mastering the Power of Creation, an Immortal King’s ability to protect themselves becomes extraordinarily strong, and escaping if they can’t win is not much of a problem.

The second type of Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King is the Supreme Immortal King.

A Supreme Immortal King has mastered the full extent of the Power of Creation, and some have even grasped more than one type of Power of Creation.

The strength of a Supreme Immortal King has almost no limit, and for some of the ancient ones, killing a Peak Immortal King is not too troublesome.

Therefore, even among Tribulation Stage Celestial Kings, Supreme Immortal Kings are absolutely not to be trifled with and are to be revered.

Of course, the number of Supreme Immortal Kings is pitifully small, and only a few, like the Supreme Immortal King, have a renowned reputation.

“To think that Martial Ancestor might actually be a Supreme Immortal King?”

The purple-robed elder’s scalp tingled, but he couldn’t help but feel curious.

In this world, everything leaves a trace, especially Supreme Immortal Kings.

Becoming a Supreme Immortal King is not something that can be achieved through seclusion alone; it requires interaction with the outside world, venturing through many secret realms. The growth trajectory of any Supreme Immortal King cannot be completely secret.

But Martial Ancestor…

The purple-robed elder thought himself well-learned but had never heard of a Supreme Immortal King associated with ‘martial’.

“Could it be that one of those undying beings from the Prehistoric Era has reemerged?” the purple-robed elder speculated secretly.

Long ago, the Spirit Realm experienced a historical discontinuity. Before the discontinuity was the Prehistoric Era.

It is said that during the Prehistoric Era of the Spirit Realm, it was immensely glorious. Immortal King Level beings roamed the universe, but due to a shocking upheaval, many Immortal Kings fell, leading to the current era of the Three Thousand Daoist States.

The purple-robed elder’s speculation about Lin Yuan could only be attributed to the Prehistoric Era; otherwise, he could not explain the sudden emergence of a Supreme Immortal King.

“Better slip away. Whether or not it’s a Supreme Immortal King from the Prehistoric Era… it’s better not to get too close…” Before understanding the character of this Supreme Immortal King, the purple-robed elder immediately planned to keep his distance.

If Lin Yuan were merely a newly ascended Immortal King, or a Veteran or Peak Immortal King, he would not mind interacting with him.

But a Supreme Immortal King, who might be from the Prehistoric Era, was something the purple-robed elder dared not approach lightly.

The stronger one is, the more clearly they understand the terror of a Supreme Immortal King, especially those from the glorious Prehistoric Era.

“Let’s go.” The purple-robed elder turned to leave.

But in the next moment.

He froze in place.

Because a figure had appeared not far away, at some unknown time, facing away from him with hands clasped behind his back.

“It’s Martial Ancestor…”

The purple-robed elder’s scalp exploded, knowing that only Martial Ancestor could have appeared beside him undetected, something not even a Peak Immortal King could achieve.

“I have seen Martial Ancestor,” the purple-robed elder said immediately with slight respect.

Since Martial Ancestor appeared here, it was a clear sign that he had been discovered, and it was obviously too late to run now.

“Mmm…” Lin Yuan glanced at the purple-robed elder and felt quite satisfied.

He had revealed part of his strength not only to promote the Martial Tao Cultivation System but also to attract other Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings.

So as to gain true upper-level information about the Spirit Realm.

The Spirit Realm is vast; the Three Thousand Daoist States are just a small part of it. If Lin Yuan were to search for those Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings himself, it would probably take a lot of time.

Instead of doing that, why not wait for them to come to him?

The moment the purple-robed elder approached Xianyao City, Lin Yuan was aware of him.

As the purple-robed elder was observing the aura of Martial Ancestor, Lin Yuan was also observing the purple-robed elder.

Although he did not know what method the purple-robed elder used, in that instant, Lin Yuan had a vague feeling of being watched.

This scrutiny was only the most superficial kind, far from detecting the core of Lin Yuan, but it was still rare.
